capabilities.claim: V1.0.3 generates a review-grade open section-loop surface graph with blade faces, segmented root blends, and open tip domes.
Section-loop blade pressure, suction, leading-edge, trailing-edge, root-blend, and open tip-dome surfaces are emitted as sampled review-grade topology faces.
V1.0.3 emits a sampled hub support surface for root projection; full native hub, bore, and bevel analytic face coverage remains partial.
V1.0.3 emits review-grade quad mesh metadata and UV wireframes for section-loop blade, root, tip, and support surfaces.
V1.0.3 bounded STEP export is generated from sampled surface graph faces as unsewn review B-Rep surfaces.
V1.0.3 does not produce solver-ready CFD volume meshes.
Expert feedback can be linked to surfaces, rules, and cases, but is not automatically converted into constructor rule patches.
